title: Briar Hydra
subtitle: Three minds. One watchful body.
interpretation: An old marsh predator interrupted at the water's edge.
gesture: The central head rises to scent the air; the left head searches low, while the right guards the coil. Unequal neck arcs leave three deliberate windows of negative space.
polish: Replace parallel upright necks with a forward-reaching S gesture and unequal head directions.
Sculpt a joined shoulder saddle and angular skull planes; bury the eyes under fitted brow ridges.
Use swept, ridged horns and a sparse dorsal crest instead of an evenly tiled ornament layer.
Keep the anchored coil quiet while necks, skulls and jaws answer each other.
nativeFeatures: Procedural pigment baked to an image
reference: The existing living Hydra is the accepted direction; this is a separate DCC interpretation, not a replacement or a pixel match.
